text:
taylor: start-of-shift handoff — quick summary for the morning crew. Overnight we saw an intermittent 503/latency spike that touched text-gen and embeddings routes across eu-west and us-west. Incident page: https://redwood.status/INC-7654 — please use that for customer-facing updates.

Impact: ~12% error rate at peak, p95 gen latency up ~2.3x for ~45 minutes. Affected customers: several PLG customers had degraded responses (email thread linked on incident page).

What we did overnight: autoscaler triggered extra nodes (k8s), we enabled a temporary fallback model variant for high-qps routes, and applied a KV-cache leader smoothing patch to reduce eviction churn. No data loss.

Current status: degraded -> stable. Error rate trending down to ~1% and p95 returning towards baseline. Batcher queue depth is still higher than normal but steady.

Primary/secondary for this shift: taylor (primary, on pager), vikram (secondary, standby until 12:00 UTC). Coverage note: APAC is uncovered for the later evening window — no APAC secondary today. If pages come from apac region route to the global oncall group.

Open issues / next steps: 
- 1) Verify KV-cache smoothing rollout completes in all regions (link to runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash).
- 2) Monitor batcher queue depth and autoscaler health for next 2 hours. Set alert if queue depth > 1200 for > 5m.
- 3) Reach out to top-affected customer POCs if error rate creeps above 3% (contacts on incident page).
- 4) If we see reappearance of 5xx > 5% re-activate the full fallback routing and consider temporarily limiting sampling for heavy customers.

Mitigation commands used (night team):
```bash
# scale batcher to reduce head-of-line blocking
kubectl -n inference scale deployment batcher --replicas=5
# activate fallback routing for text-gen high-qps paths
curl -s -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/route/fallback" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"route":"text-gen","variant":"quantized-small"}'
```

Notes for whoever takes this: check both observability dashboards (console -> models -> text-gen) and the autoscaler logs (k8s events). If you need quick rollback for the KV patch: see the runbook link above, section 'rollback-quick'.

vikram: thanks — I'm on standby. I validated the fallback routing is hitting ~18% of traffic for the heavy customers and their 200->503 ratio dropped significantly. I also saw a thundering leader election event at 03:12 UTC in eu-west which lines up with the p95 spike. Will keep watching.

matt: pinging from infra — we saw one k8s node with repeated OOMs that might explain some pod churn; we evacuated the node and cordoned it. Node id: node-cc-12. No immediate action required but flagging for capacity team.

taylor: noted. I'll add node-cc-12 to the investigation doc on the incident page. For now it's cordoned and drained.

emily: FYI I adjusted alert thresholds to reduce noisy pages: lowered the sensitivity on ephemeral 502 alerts, kept the 503 threshold strict. If you want the exact rule I edited it's `svc/gen-5xx > 3% for 3m`.

lina: quick heads-up — customer ops asked for a short postmortem template. I drafted one under the incident page (https://redwood.status/INC-7654/postmortem-draft). If we keep it contained we can share an initial summary with affected customers by EOD.

oncall-bot: reminder — please ack the incident page and mark primary/secondary if you take over. Use `/oncall ack 7201234567` to record the handoff.

taylor: taking the remainder of the morning shift. Next check-in at 30 minutes or sooner if we see >2% error creep. Action items assigned: vikram will watch the KV rollout, matt will follow up on node-cc-12 with infra, emily will monitor alerts and adjust if noisy. Lina will prep customer notes if we reach >3% sustained.

Notes/action log (short):
- 03:05 UTC: pager -> 3 pages (auto-scaling + 5xx spike)
- 03:12 UTC: KV leader election observed (eu-west)
- 03:20 UTC: batcher scaled to 5 replicas
- 03:26 UTC: fallback model enabled for heavy routes
- 04:00 UTC: error rate down to ~2%

If anyone picks this up later please paste your name at top and include any changes to routing, scaling, or runbook steps. Cheers and good handoff. :coffee:
